summary: Added test/self-heal.test.js (plain-node harness, native-write.test.js style). Refactored sweepStaleClaims to delegate to a pure staleClaimKeys(overlay,agents,nowMs) predicate (exported) so the reaper is unit-testable; behavior unchanged. Reaper tests: a dead-agent in_progress orphan (stale lastChanged, agent.state!=running) is selected once; a live worker and a fresh claim are NOT reaped; after clearing the override a second pass selects nothing (idempotent). Surfacing tests: stale tested/ready nodes yield exactly the right set, live-owner/fresh/in_progress are excluded, status is never mutated, second enqueue is idempotent. 18/18 pass; whole suite (21 files) green. Edited via /tmp+cp.
